claim_boundary.role: previously opened difficult development sentinel; not an unbiased confirmatory scene
known_before_registration: post-metric diagnosis that the source-selected threshold 0.71 is above a stronger target operating point near 0.66
K16-only source-footprint OOF selected propagation but did not predict its novel-view regression
claim_boundary.forbidden_use: No previously opened target RGB, target mask, target score, target metric, or post-metric threshold may enter OOF construction, completion-threshold selection, source-visible coverage, or candidate prediction.

question: Can a source-only cross-fitted calibration distinguish source-visible rows from completion rows while preserving the frozen factorized SPIn matched interface?

full_fit_pre_metric_prediction_receipt.use: source-visible threshold and immutable continuous target-score bindings only

matched_oof_contract.base_compiler: the existing exact-W K4 source-footprint fold with all evidence tensors cleared on one complete held-out footprint group fold before compilation
matched_oof_contract.base_graph_and_stage: the same factorized surface-safe K16 and propagated readout already sealed in each source fold
matched_oof_contract.bandwidth_origin: the source-only selected Lego matched-interface operating point is now frozen as a single development-method constant; it is not rescanned in OOF
matched_oof_contract.readout: K201 propagated support; connected selection off
matched_oof_contract.heldout_semantics: Held-out rows have exact zero positive evidence and exact zero reference sample weight before logistic fit, graph reachability, or any query-conditioned operation.

calibration_contract.tie_break: strict improvement retains the first descending threshold
calibration_contract.t_seen: The score_threshold in the immutable full-fit pre-metric receipt; no evaluation report is read.
calibration_contract.t_completion: One pooled threshold maximizing responsibility-weighted soft IoU over exactly the held-out observed rows from the three matched-interface OOF folds.
calibration_contract.fold_stability: Report each fold threshold and require max-minus-min <= 0.10 before any target prediction.
calibration_contract.source_visible_row: reference_weight > 0 in the immutable full source evidence authority
calibration_contract.target_camera_coverage: Render the binary source-visible row indicator with the same alpha-normalized scalar Gaussian compositor and the target pose; no target raster, RGB, feature, or mask is opened.

cpu_preflight_stop_rules: Fail closed unless exactly folds 0,1,2 share scene, protocol, graph, capability, footprint, relation, KNN, row, geometry, and method-contract authorities.
Fail closed if any held-out source evidence or reference sample weight survives.
Stop before target rendering if any fold is class-degenerate or if the three completion thresholds span more than 0.10.
Do not change the block grid, fold assignment, K, bandwidth, regularizer, threshold grid, visibility definition, interpolation formula, or stability bound after observing the result.

development_sentinel_gate.promotion: candidate foreground IoU must be at least 0.6346096108315573 and strictly exceed 0.6331459007792092
development_sentinel_gate.prediction_separation: All continuous scores, coverage maps, spatial thresholds, and binary predictions must be sealed before the frozen target masks are opened for this new evaluation.
development_sentinel_gate.failure: Stop this calibration branch without exponent, blend, threshold, fold, or scene-specific tuning.

forbidden: target RGB or target foundation-model features
target masks or metrics before candidate prediction receipt
the known post-metric target threshold near 0.66 as an input
using the old K16-only pooled diagnostic threshold as t_completion
bandwidth, coverage exponent, interpolation-weight, fold-count, block-grid, or threshold-grid scans
modification of NVOS source-completion or source-observation gates

execution.gpu_rule: After CPU implementation, tests, and stability tooling are complete, report the exact GPU command and resource estimate before any Lego matched-OOF or target-coverage run.
